title: Compose real local Event Search → Inspection → separately authorized Pivot Query draft → Search return
goal: Deliver one meaningful bounded analyst journey reusing the source-identical browser-to-Go Inspection bridge from immutable #185 and the L2-corrected host action authorization from #189. A selected authorized Event field prepares a read-only CAP-INV-002 Query draft with validated provenance and restored Search context; never execute/persist a Query.
invariants: Preserve historical #185 SHA d1544e255b9d595357c3f6ed2c2cf23a270f247a and #189 SHA 0393782e75f8a94705ea8f5256421f96715c02c0; only new integration branch changes.
Seven immutable source blobs from #185 imported with identical Git object hashes before extension; no alternate HTTP/IAM/pivot engine.
Search job/tenant/environment/event/source/correlation context is sourced from the currently visible authorized Search row; browser never grants access.
The Go host independently checks SessionResolver, SearchOwner, TelemetryOwner and distinct PivotAuthorizer before returning only an unexecuted pivot draft.
Browser validates draft job/run/event/time/field/value/provenance/return origin against currently authorized Inspector and Search result; only one visible field origin and raw/field action guards.
Every HTTP action uses fixed same-origin relative paths, POST, no-store, redirects denied, strict JSON and <=2MiB UTF8 stream; no URL supplied by client.
OPEN-013/014 Class-2 mutations and Query execution not implemented; no production provider, IAM, audit persistence or TLS deployment claims.
security_properties: No silent pivot on mere Event.read, no copied raw-derived field if raw denied, no source label spoof accepted into draft.
Stale/cancelled/browsed-away Search/Inspector response never presents a draft; same Search window restored only if authorized job remains current.
A failed or 404 pivot causes generic unavailable view without returning sensitive backend error details.
Native DOM uses textContent for both Inspector and draft; pivot buttons are opt-in and only for unique already visible field-value origins.

migration.rationale: New browser journey action and synthetic host fixture only; no persistent object/schema or executed action.

rollback.strategy: Revert K integration only. Independent #185 Inspector and #189 host remain unchanged and reviewable.
verification: Existing HTTP inspection and browser Search flow remain independently exercised
No historical SHA or canonical contract altered

inputs: CAP-INV-004 §12 Pivoter Class-0 and §17 Inspector→Event Search return
CAP-INV-002 Query draft scope, no automatic Query execution
Existing Go host corrected action-specific trust in #189, immutable #185 Node bridge copied in one commit
outputs: An actual user-selected field from the existing Inspector becomes a server-revalidated, unexecuted Query draft with source provenance/time/return context.
Original frontend JavaScript and Go fixture are connected through actual Node fetch to Go HTTP with distinct synthetic host PivotAuthorizer.
Existing Inspector source information and return to identical Search window remain available, including action denied and stale route cancellation.
Exact-SHA three-platform Go and Node frontend tests, bounded transport and compulsory engineering-kernel checks.
acceptance_tests: Actual loopback Go host permits `source.ip` pivot only with distinct host-authorized action; binds Search Job, Event, tenant and origin, and preserves the client-supplied time range (syntactic validation only, no trusted Search Job interval comparison); no Query execution.
A different visible enrichment is denied by independent PivotAuthorizer and does not reveal raw secret or partial draft.
A raw-denied `secret.token` is not a pivot option; forged host pivot field origin or return context is rejected client-side.
Concurrent/cancelled pivot after return to Search yields superseded and cannot restore previously drafted data.
Prior Go Inspector HTTP and full Node Event Search suites pass on same exact integration SHA.
Mandatory security, coverage, formatting, architecture and manifest CI verified before L2 and any merge.
required_checks: Event Search to Event Inspection live local HTTP integration
definition_of_ready: Existing source H browser bridge immutable #185 and fixed pivot host J immutable #189 are code published with exact SHA CI, but their PRs remain DRAFT and not product accepted.
All permissions remain host-controlled; Class-2 and actual Query execution explicitly excluded.
definition_of_done: A selected Inspector field produces a response-verified Query draft through real Go HTTP fixture with denial and stale tests
Exact-SHA CI mandatory checks PASS with no lowered security floor
Reviewable bounded branch and L2 material integration context, no main/production acceptance claim.

performance_budget.rationale: One existing authorized inspection HTTP request and one optional action-specific pivot draft request; fixed <=2MiB response; synthetic local not production SLO.
metrics: one additional POST only when analyst explicitly selects a field
fixed 2MiB read ceiling and 4096-byte selected field cap server-side
no background execution, writes or paid APIs
